paper_metadata.title: Utilising Ti3Sn intermetallic precipitates to achieve high strength Ti-Nb-Sn alloys

evidence.quote: This study considers a series of Ti-Nb-Sn alloys to indicate the phase boundaries of the Ti3Sn intermetallic phase and considers the effect of this intermetallic precipitate on the mechanical response.
A series of Ti-Nb-Sn alloys were investigated to explore the compo - sitional space for which grain boundary pinning intermetallic pre - cipitates could be produced.

The 4Sn alloys, shown in Fig. 1 a, did not contain any additional sharp reflections suggesting they were free of any intermetallic precipitate.

The EDX maps showed clear segregation of Sn to the secondary phase and a corresponding depletion in Nb. This elemental segregation was consistent with the crystallographic phase identification from XRD suggesting that the observed precipitate was Ti3Sn.
